item.text: The spatial goals reduce to reversing at most five existing cell assertions and adding the terminal emp. I’ll construct that rearrangement with heap joins and reuse it for the disjunction and return proofs.

var candidate = await fs.readFile(p+'/Candidate.v','utf8'); var helpers = `
Local Lemma finite_refl (P : CRules.expr) : P |-- P.
Proof. intros h H; exact H. Qed.
Local Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : CRules.expr) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros H1 H2 h H; exact (H2 h (H1 h H)). Qed.
Local Lemma finite_frame (P P' Q Q' : CRules.expr) :
  (P |-- P') -> (Q |-- Q') -> (P ** Q |-- P' ** Q').
Proof.
  intros HP HQ h [a [b [J [A B]]]].
  exists a, b; split; [exact J|split; [apply HP; exact A|apply HQ; exact B]].
Qed.
Local Lemma finite_unit (P : CRules.expr) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros h H. destruct (unit_join h) as [u [U J]].
  exists h, u; split; [exact J|split; assumption].
Qed.
Local Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : CRules.expr) :
  (P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R).
Proof.
  intros h [ab [c [J [ [a [b [K [A B]]]] C]]]].
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J) as [bc [L M]].
  exists a, bc; split; [exact M|split; [exact A|]].
  exists b, c; split; [exact L|split; assumption].
Qed.
Local Lemma finite_swap (P Q R : CRules.expr) :
  P ** (Q ** R) |-- Q ** (P ** R).
Proof.
  intros h [a [bc [J [A [b [c [K [B C]]]]]]]].
  pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ J) as J'.
  destruct (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J') as [ca [L M]].
  exists b, ca; split; [exact M|split; [exact B|]].
  exists a, c; split; [apply join_comm; exact L|split; assumption].
Qed.

Ltac finite_chain s tail :=
  lazymatch s with
  | ?a ** ?b => let t := finite_chain b tail in finite_chain a t
  | _ => constr:(s ** tail)
  end.
Ltac finite_normalize :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- (?a ** ?b) ** ?tail |-- _ =>
      let bt := finite_chain b tail in
      eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|];
      eapply finite_trans with (Q := a ** bt);
      [apply finite_frame; [apply finite_refl|finite_normalize]|finite_normalize]
  | |- _ => apply finite_refl
  end.
Ltac finite_remove x s :=
  lazymatch s with
  | ?a ** ?b =>
      tryif unify a x then constr:(b)
      else let r := finite_remove x b in constr:(a ** r)
  end.
Ltac finite_pick :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- ?s |-- ?x ** ?r =>
      lazymatch s with
      | ?a ** ?b =>
          tryif unify a x then apply finite_refl
          else let br := finite_remove x b in
            eapply finite_trans with (Q := a ** (x ** br));
            [apply finite_frame; [apply finite_refl|finite_pick]|apply finite_swap]
      end
  end.
Ltac finite_arrange :=
  first [apply finite_refl |
    lazymatch goal with
    | |- ?s |-- ?a ** ?b =>
        let r := finite_remove a s in
        eapply finite_trans with (Q := a ** r);
        [finite_pick|apply finite_frame; [apply finite_refl|finite_arrange]]
    | |- _ => intros h H; cbn [andp coq_prop];
        repeat first [exact H | reflexivity | split]
    end].
Ltac finite_cells :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- ?s |-- _ =>
      let t := finite_chain s emp in
      eapply finite_trans with (Q := t);
      [eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_unit|finite_normalize]|finite_arrange]
  end.
Ltac finite_full :=
  cbn [CharArray.full store_array store_array_rec repeat_Z
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA];
  rewrite ?sizeof_char; cbn; finite_cells.
Ltac finite_undef :=
  cbn [CharArray.undef_full store_undef_array store_undef_array_rec
       StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA];
  rewrite ?sizeof_char; cbn; finite_cells.

`; candidate=candidate.replace('\n\nTheorem','\n'+helpers+'Theorem'); var i=0; var proofs=[`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial; finite_full.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_1; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial; finite_full.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_2; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_2_split_goal_spatial.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial; finite_full.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_3; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_3_split_goal_spatial.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_4_split_goal_spatial; finite_full.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_4; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_4_split_goal_spatial.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_5_split_goal_spatial; finite_full.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_5; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_5_split_goal_spatial.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_6_split_goal_1.\n  intros h H; cbn [coq_prop repeat_Z]; reflexivity.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_6_split_goal_spatial; finite_undef.`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_entail_wit_6; right.\n  intros h H; split.\n  - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_6_split_goal_1 h H).\n  - exact (resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_6_split_goal_spatial h H).`,`unfold ExecutionGoal.init_array2_return_wit_1; right.\n  intros n_pre p_pre H1 H2 H3 H4 H5 H6 Hp Hn H9 H10.\n  subst n_pre; subst p_pre.\n  rewrite sizeof_char.\n  intros h H; exists (repeat_Z 0 5).\n  apply resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_1_split_goal_spatial.\n  exact H.`]; candidate=candidate.replace(/Proof\.
